task: Fix Lattice CLI dead-ends for mid-flight stories missing verificationIntent and wrapper-root projects using configured gitRoot worktree bootstrap.
outcome: A user can run lattice verification_intent_repair on a legacy story and see a terminal summary like Repaired 21 missing verificationIntent entries from existing passing evidence; story_review no longer reports missing verification_intent for those lanes. In a wrapper-root project with gitRoot configured, story_advance to INIT_CHECK creates the story worktree and prints the worktree path instead of forcing manual worktree creation.
facts: ClawCreek B-5a12 had completed verificationEvidence but checklist items lacked verificationIntent.
story_review currently blocks missing verificationIntent even when evidence refs exist.
checklist_update --help was re-tested in the current global CLI and now succeeds, so sourceManifestDigest implementation changes are excluded.
session_brief can resolve configured gitRoot signed workspace roots.
INIT_CHECK bootstrap should run git operations from the material git root, not blindly from metadata root.
constraints: Preserve verificationIntent as the acceptance contract.
Do not let verificationEvidence silently replace intent for normal stories.
Repair must be explicit, audited, phase-aware, and non-overwriting by default.
Do not mutate DONE or DISCARDED stories automatically.
Do not touch sourceManifestDigest unless the help-command failure reproduces as a separate defect.
Do not read or write .omx and do not directly edit story JSON or fixture JSON.
